doc_kind: Medicaid policy (Medi-Cal managed care medical policy)
lines_of_business: Blue Shield of California Promise Health Plan Medi-Cal (San Diego, Los Angeles Counties)
effective_or_revised: Original Policy Date December 1, 2025; Effective June 1, 2026
criteria_location: Policy Statement pp.1-3, with Medi-Cal state guidelines above it that 'supersede'. Policy Guidelines pp.3-6 are non-binding clinical input. 100 pages total.

logic.top_level: pathways (16 covered indications; diabetic wounds and ISSHL have sub-criteria)
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Investigational list 'in all other situations, including but not limited to'.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: None in criteria. Policy Guidelines recite UHMS regimens: 'reevaluation at 30-day intervals must show continued progress', 'Review is indicated after 10 treatments'.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Idiopathic sudden sensorineural hearing loss (SSNHL) and either of the following: 1. ... within 2 weeks ... 2. ... as salvage within 1 month
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Sub-items are an any-of, but the lead-in uses 'and'; conditions mix steroid co-therapy with timing

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Any criteria that are not specifically addressed in the above Provider Manuals, please refer to the criteria below.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Medi-Cal manual 'supersedes' but has 'no specific clinical guidelines', so the delegation resolves to the policy

requirement_kinds.quote: Acute carbon monoxide poisoning; Acute cyanide poisoning; Acute gas embolism ...
no measurable signs of healing after 30 days of an adequate course of standard wound therapy
wound classified as Wagner grade 3 or higher
combined with steroid therapy within 2 weeks of onset of SSNHL
combined with steroid therapy as salvage within 1 month of onset of SSNHL
Profound anemia with exceptional blood loss and either of the following: transfusion impossible; must be delayed

thresholds.quote: HBOT refers to treatment at pressures greater than 1.4 atmospheres absolute

time_windows.quote: after 30 days of an adequate course of standard wound therapy

time_windows.length: within 2 weeks of onset; salvage within 1 month
time_windows.quote: within 2 weeks of onset of SSNHL

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: Listed only; 'Inclusion or exclusion of a code(s) does not constitute or imply member coverage'. Medi-Cal manuals list the codes (TAR/non-standard benefits).

external_dependencies.what: Medi-Cal Provider Manual and TAR lists supersede policy statement
external_dependencies.quote: this guideline supersedes the criteria in the Policy Statement section below
For Members less than 21 years of age, a service is Medically Necessary if it meets the Early and Periodic Screening, Diagnostic, and Treatment (EPSDT) standard

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: reasonable and necessary services to protect life, to prevent significant illness or significant disability, or alleviate severe pain

vague_terms.problem: policy itself says 'No definition of "progressive" was identified'

vague_terms.quote: adequate course of standard wound therapy
Acute arterial peripheral insufficiency (outside of other listed medically necessary indications involving arterial insufficiency)

extraction_hazards: 100 pages; criteria p.1-3, Appendix A repeats the policy twice in side-by-side BEFORE/AFTER columns, creating duplicate text
Policy Statement preceded by supersession language
Appendix 1 contains stakeholder comments that read like criteria (e.g. UHMS 24-hour CRAO window)
Superscript reference numbers fused to text ('indication.1')
interesting_structures: Medicaid hierarchy: state guideline first, plan policy as fallback
Policy Guidelines say timing 'no broad statements ... can be provided' for CRAO despite 24-hour UHMS window

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = all/any/not expresses it cleanly ... 5 = needs new constructs
fit_to_tree.why: Criteria are plain any/all, but the document defers to a state manual that may override them and contains non-binding guidance mixed in; Medicaid precedence is a meta-rule outside the tree.
